description: This source file defines the JavaEventHandler class, which implements event handling for web requests within the OFBiz framework. It loads handler classes dynamically, invokes specified methods via reflection, manages transactions, and logs processing details.

classes.name: JavaEventHandler
classes.description: A static utility class for handling web events by dynamically invoking methods based on configuration, with transaction management and logging.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class given its class path as a string, logs an error if the class cannot be loaded.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization method for the event handler, currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method that handles invocation of event-related methods. Loads the class if not already loaded, manages transactions, invokes the specified method via reflection, and handles exceptions and logging.
